text: {"name":"wlc_frame_activity_update","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Updates per-context flags from the 802.11 frame-control and multicast fields, scheduling deferred work when the associated state changes.","subsystem":"wlan","var_renames":{"a1":"frame","a2":"input_flags","a3":"frame_context","v3":"global_state","v4":"frame_control","v8":"context_flags"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":4,"meaning":"32-bit context flag word; bit 1 is toggled in the multicast path and bit 2 in the other path."},{"offset":114,"meaning":"Byte predicate that suppresses setting the multicast More Data flag."},{"offset":20,"meaning":"Saved frame-context pointer in the global state structure."},{"offset":29,"meaning":"Deferred-work state byte; values 0, 2, and 5 are used."}]}
